anchor: Curated SMB-first taxonomy (Plan v4.0). Sectors per sectors.json v4 master menu.
convention: Each industry has friendly `name`, bracket `examples`, lowercase `keywords`, parent `sector_id`, classification anchors, and an `audience` tag controlling default UI visibility. Sub-niches use `parent_id` pointing to the measured parent industry — when no direct measurement exists for a sub-niche, queries fall back to the parent.

audience_legend.smb_core: SMBs dominate by count and economic relevance — always visible
audience_legend.smb_friendly: SMBs participate meaningfully alongside a big-corp tail — always visible, with optional firm-size caveat
audience_legend.mixed_caution: Bimodal; average can mislead — hidden by default, available via ?show_mixed=1
audience_legend.corp_only: Large corporations dominate; SMB participation is negligible — Pro-tier toggle only
